learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to break down complex technical challenges of vehicle development into sub-aspects and work on them in networked groups with defined interfaces.
They know organizational contexts and workflows in automotive development and the necessary project management.
They can describe and independently carry out development work from needs analysis to practical testing to propose new solutions for current problems.

syllabus_topics: Organizational structures of automotive groups and necessary communication channels
Strategic task planning for the development of a research vehicle
Needs analysis, definition, calculation, simulation, and test execution in the individual phases of vehicle development
Execution of individual development steps on a real vehicle
Project work in a team with in-depth study of a selected topic
assessment_rules: The module examination must be passed to receive credit points. The grade is weighted according to ECTS credit points.
